summary: Join our training course to master the art of designing compensation and reward systems. Equip yourself with essential tools for effective employee motivation.
lede: Compensation and reward design helps HR professionals and managers make practical decisions about pay, recognition, and incentives. Participants learn to evaluate roles, build salary structures and pay ranges, and connect performance to financial and non-financial rewards. They also explore internal equity, reward budgeting, and ways to communicate and review pay frameworks for decisions such as salary reviews and incentive plans.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals who manage, influence, or rely on compensation and reward decisions.
audience: HR managers and HR business partners
Compensation and benefits specialists or analysts
Business unit heads or project leaders
modules: Foundations of Compensation and Reward Strategy
Job Analysis, Evaluation, and Pay Structures
Base Pay Design and Salary Management
Variable Pay, Incentives, and Bonus Schemes
Non-Financial Rewards and Total Rewards Mix
Performance Management and Pay for Performance
Compliance, Policies, and Risk Management in Compensation
Budgeting, Costing, and ROI of Reward Programs
Communicating, Implementing, and Reviewing Reward Systems
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of HR principles and be involved in HR, finance, or management roles.
